Title:     Mongo DB /Sigma Configuration Developer ​( Locals preferred) 
 Location: Richardson, TX​  
 Duration: Contract 3+ months plus extension ( GC/Citizens) 
 Rate : DOE 
 Job Description: 
 The ideal candidate must act as a MongoDB developer/designer for major telecommunications ordering system.
 Must effectively use analytical, problem solving, technical skills, available technology, and tools in the evaluation of client requirements and processes.
 Provide designs, specify integration and data access solutions in the development of new or existing data integration solutions using Mongo to solve basic to complex problems or create enhancements.
 Work closely with other team members, and owners of the data sources to provide qualitative and quantitative analysis.
 Responsible for providing user access to the data via appropriate designs of the solutions
 


 EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE: 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field of study or related experience
 Extensive experience with   MONGO DB   including hands-on, pragmatic working knowledge
 Considerable Database development experience / background
 7+ yrs of Experience with   MS SQL   Server
 Problem solving / troubleshooting experience /skills to assist Production Support in issue resolution
 Excellent communication skills (must be able to interface with both technical and business leaders in the organization)
 Ability to provide data visualization solutions.
 Basic ability to work independently and manage one's time. --Basic knowledge of computer hardware and software
